claims.text: Park Hyatt Tokyo occupies the 39th to 52nd floors of Shinjuku Park Tower, in Shinjuku on the west side of Tokyo.

findings.quote: Located on the west side of Tokyo in Shinjuku, Park Hyatt Tokyo occupies the 39th to 52nd floors of Shinjuku Park Tower

claims.text: Shinjuku Park Tower was designed by Pritzker Prize-winner Kenzo Tange.

findings.quote: Shinjuku Park Tower, a modern Japanese architectural masterpiece designed by Pritzker Prize-winner Kenzo Tange

claims.text: Rooms feature curated artwork, bespoke furnishings and views of Tokyo.

findings.quote: Each space features curated artwork, bespoke furnishings and breathtaking views of Tokyo

claims.text: Club On The Park is a two-story skylit spa and fitness center.

findings.quote: Club On The Park is a two-story skylit oasis with a 2,100-square-meter (22,600-square-foot) spa and fitness center

claims.text: The indoor pool at Club On The Park has panoramic views of Tokyo and Mt. Fuji through floor-to-ceiling glass walls.

findings.quote: The centerpiece of Club On The Park is an 8-by-20-meter (26-by-65-foot) pool with fitness and stretching studios on either side, plus sweeping panoramic views of Tokyo and Mt. Fuji through floor-to-ceiling glass walls.

claims.text: New York Bar has nightly jazz performances with a Tokyo night view as the backdrop.

findings.quote: Connected to New York Grill, nightly jazz performances, a captivating Tokyo night view as the stage backdrop

claims.text: Girandole by Alain Ducasse is a French brasserie with a double-level collage of 144 black-and-white photographs by Vera Mercer.

findings.quote: French brasserie culture at its finest
An iconic double-level collage of 144 black-and-white photographs by Vera Mercer, celebrates European café life.

claims.text: The Peak Lounge & Bar serves afternoon tea in a glass atrium surrounded by a bamboo grove with views of Mt. Fuji.

findings.quote: By day, enjoy an artfully redefined afternoon tea set in a spectacular glass atrium surrounded by a serene bamboo grove with unparalleled views of Mt. Fuji.

claims.text: A complimentary shuttle runs daily between the hotel's main entrance and Shinjuku station every 30 minutes.

findings.quote: A complimentary shuttle (maximum 9 passengers) service departs daily from the hotel's main entrance to Shinjuku station every 30 minutes from 9:00 am to 9:00 pm.

claims.text: The hotel reopened on December 9, 2025 after a 19-month renovation.

findings.quote: thoroughly reinterpreted during a 19-month renovation. It reopened December 9, 2025.

claims.text: Cribs, high chairs and kids' menus are available, and kids under 12 stay free.

findings.quote: Cribs, high chairs and kids’ menus are available, and kids under 12 stay free.

claims.text: Meiji Jingu shrine in Yoyogi Park is a 15-20 minute walk south.

findings.quote: Yoyogi Park and its Meiji Jingu shrine, an appealing year-round destination for nature walks under a dense tree canopy and a harmonizing dose of Japanese shinto spirituality just a 15-20 minute straight shot south on foot
